name: onemap-tools
description: OneMap Singapore API tools for AI Foundry - comprehensive Singapore mapping, geocoding, routing, and demographic data

tools.name: search
tools.description: Search for address information for roads, buildings, postal codes, etc. Takes text input and returns address information including coordinates.

tools.name: reverse_geocode_wgs84
tools.description: Get address information for a location using WGS84 coordinates (lat/lon).

tools.name: reverse_geocode_svy21
tools.description: Get address information for a location using SVY21 coordinates (X/Y).

tools.name: route_walk_drive_cycle
tools.description: Get walking, driving, cycling, or barrier-free route between two points.

tools.name: route_public_transport
tools.description: Get public transport route between two points with bus/MRT details.

tools.name: convert_4326_to_3857
tools.description: Convert WGS84 (lat/lon) to Web Mercator (EPSG:3857) coordinates.

tools.name: convert_4326_to_3414
tools.description: Convert WGS84 (lat/lon) to SVY21 (EPSG:3414) coordinates.

tools.name: convert_3414_to_4326
tools.description: Convert SVY21 (EPSG:3414) to WGS84 (lat/lon) coordinates.

tools.name: get_all_themes_info
tools.description: Get list of all available thematic layers in OneMap (100+ government data layers).

more_info.description: Include icon names, category names, and theme owners

tools.name: retrieve_theme
tools.description: Retrieve all data for a specific theme, optionally within a bounding box.

tools.name: get_all_planning_areas
tools.description: Get all 55 planning area polygons in Singapore.

tools.name: get_planning_area_by_location
tools.description: Get the planning area for a specific location.

tools.name: get_population_age_group
tools.description: Get population by age group for a planning area.

tools.name: get_ethnic_distribution
tools.description: Get ethnic group distribution for a planning area.

tools.name: get_nearby_mrt_stations
tools.description: Find nearby MRT and LRT stations from a given location.

tools.name: get_nearby_bus_stops
tools.description: Find nearby bus stops from a given location.

tools.name: get_static_map
tools.description: Generate a static map image in PNG format with optional overlays (points, lines, polygons).

tools.name: ura_private_residential_transactions
tools.description: Get private residential property sales transactions from URA (past 5 years). Returns transaction records including sale price, area, tenure (freehold/99-year/etc), district, project name, and transaction date. Useful for land sales and property price research.

batch.description: Batch number 1-4, split by postal districts: 1 = districts 01-07, 2 = districts 08-14, 3 = districts 15-21, 4 = districts 22-28.

tools.name: ura_private_rental_contracts
tools.description: Get private residential rental contracts from URA (past 5 years). Returns rental contract records including monthly rent, floor area, property type, and district information.

ref_period.description: Reference quarter in yyqq format (e.g., '25q1' for 2025 Q1).

tools.name: ura_median_rentals
tools.description: Get median rentals for private non-landed residential properties from URA (past 3 years). Returns median rental data with 25th percentile, median, and 75th percentile PSF values.

tools.name: ura_developer_sales
tools.description: Get private residential units sold by developers from URA (past 3 years). Returns prices and sales data for completed and uncompleted private residential units and executive condominiums.

ref_period.description: Reference month in mmyy format (e.g., '0925' for Sep 2025).

tools.name: ura_residential_pipeline
tools.description: Get private residential projects in the pipeline from URA. Returns information about upcoming residential projects including project name, unit counts by type, expected TOP year, and developer name.

tools.name: ura_planning_decisions
tools.description: Get planning application decisions from URA. Returns information about Written Permission applications granted or rejected, including submission details, decision type, site address, and MK/TS lot number.

year.description: Year to retrieve planning decisions for (records after 2000 only).

tools.name: ura_car_park_availability
tools.description: Get real-time URA car park availability (updates every 3-5 minutes). Returns live availability data with car park code, lot type, available lots, and coordinates in SVY21 format.

tools.name: ura_car_park_details
tools.description: Get URA car park list and parking rates. Returns detailed information about URA short-term car parks including rates, parking hours, capacity, and coordinates.

authentication.description: OneMap email and password for authentication (https://www.onemap.gov.sg/apidocs/). URA access key for property/planning data (https://eservice.ura.gov.sg/maps/api/).
